stem: Which condition most clearly signals that routine verification may have crossed into servicing?
choices: The task takes more than five minutes.
The task requires protected access, guard removal, disassembly or control of hazardous/stored energy.
A supervisor is not standing nearby.
rationale: The task requires protected access, guard removal, disassembly or control of hazardous/stored energy. This preserves the evidence and role boundary required by the referenced verification framework.
